scope: Ordinary female LH/FSH educational age reference; no laboratory RI, diagnostic category, SDS, history migration or geometric recalibration.
ownerDecision: After reviewing the source-priority proposal, the owner requested the next recommended implementation step. Clinical validation is not asserted.

rationale.selected: Age-model Madsen for both female gonadotropins from 6 through the exact published 16-year endpoint, independently of Th. Zec FSH remains from 1 to less than 6 with current typed Th1.
rationale.alternativeConsidered: Retain Zec for current Th1 at 6–<11 and Madsen for other/missing stages. This changes population, statistic and assay reference when Th is entered or becomes historical.
rationale.basis: Consistency of an educational age comparison and existing male FSH source routing; no evidence of numerical assay superiority or calibration between publications.
rationale.tradeoff: F9/Th1 FSH reference changes from Zec 1.55 to Madsen 1.964770298470689 IU/L. Reported Roche cobas e411 no longer qualifies for this age profile. No hidden source fallback after method rejection.

madsen2022.freshVerification: Full article: Cohort Description, Table 1, Blood Sample Analyses, Hormone Reference Intervals, Continuous Hormone References and Discussion; official supplement version 1 reopened and all 22 existing female medians checked against original cells.
madsen2022.population: Cross-sectional BGS2, Norway, approximately 90% European ancestry, mixed pubertal stages; Table 1 reports 601 available female blood samples, not per-analyte N.
madsen2022.observedAges: 6–<16 years; Fit Futures older participants extend steroid models, not LH/FSH.
madsen2022.specimen: Serum, sampled 08:00–14:00, stored at −80 degrees C.
sourceLimitations: Oral-contraceptive users excluded from all female models.
Menstrual-cycle phase was not standardized; authors advise consulting additional reference intervals for menstruating girls.
Age models do not infer Tanner stage, cycle phase or an individual longitudinal trajectory.
LH medians in early childhood are near LLOQ; small numerical differences do not establish puberty onset.
No documented patient-value imputation rule permits replacing censored results with LOD/2.

supplement.transformation: p50 IU/L = exp(M)/1000000; M is not a concentration in IU/L.
supplement.interpolation: Existing PCHIP between all 11 annual nodes per hormone; application approximation, not a new GAMLSS fit.

madsen2022.endpointPolicy: Use the published [6,16] model domain including exact node 16, matching existing male and comparison policies. The complete possible age interval must fit; [16,16+1/12) does not. Never extrapolate beyond 16.

zec2012.freshVerificationBoundary: Bibliography and abstract reconfirmed. Full PDF was not accessible in this review; use the existing documented owner-supplied full-PDF extraction, with no new source numbers or eligibility claims.
zec2012.location: Table 2, journal page 1210 / PDF page 5; assay Table 1, page 1208 / PDF page 3.
zec2012.population: Zagreb, Croatia, Tanner I only; clinical hospital/outpatient recruitment, not solely healthy volunteers. Full cohort 948; FSH 807 measurements.
zec2012.materialLimitation: Serum and lithium-heparin plasma collected; analyte-specific matrix not reported.
zec2012.sourceGroupPolicy: N, median and labels continue to describe the full published group. A narrower application window is not a newly analyzed subgroup. Original evidence and male routing retained.

applicationContextPolicy.knownPregnancy: Conservative application exclusion, not presented as a documented Madsen recruitment criterion. Reuse only explicit current same-patient pregnancy already available in the converter.
applicationContextPolicy.knownTreatment: Preserve known positive hormonal treatment, GnRHa, COC, exogenous testosterone and stimulation facts where available. Do not copy assay/material/protocol belonging to a different analyte.
applicationContextPolicy.unknown: Missing treatment or COC history remains unknown, not confirmed absence; no new questionnaire or claim of complete COC detection from the patient record.
applicationContextPolicy.identityAndTime: Current facts must not leak across patient/sex changes or onto a dated historical specimen; local context reset preserved.
applicationContextPolicy.separateClinicalAssessment: Laboratory age/stage references and development warnings retain independent eligibility and interpretation.
